extracted.intended_audience: Principal investigators and other senior/key personnel preparing NIH PHS 398 biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and example content for completing the PHS 398 / 2590 biographical sketch page for senior/key personnel and other significant contributors on NIH grant applications, including required sections and page limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical sketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the specified format for each person; the entire biographical sketch must not exceed four pages. Use the Biographical Sketch Format Page (PHS 398/2590) layout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the individual's full name as the heading of the biographical sketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: eRA Commons user name
rubrics_metrics.description: eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the applicant's eRA Commons username or other credential/login as requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Position title
rubrics_metrics.description: POSITION TITLE Principal, Pat Garrett Consulting (example).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List current position title(s) relevant to the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training (institution, degree, dates, field)
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable.) INSTITUTION AND LOCATION DEGREE (if applicable) MM/YY FIELD OF STUDY
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a chronological (beginning with baccalaureate) list of institutions and locations, degrees (if applicable), month/year of degree, and field of study. Include postdoctoral and residency training where applicable. Use the table format shown (institution/location | degree | MM/YY | field).

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a concise narrative statement summarizing the individual's qualifications, relevant experience, and roles that justify their participation on the project. The example demonstrates summarizing past projects, specific expertise (e.g., assembling well-characterized sample panels, managing multi-site collections), prior collaborations, and planned role on the proposed grant (e.g., anticipated appointment percentage and PI role). Use concrete examples of prior relevant work to support suitability.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors (positions, employment, memberships)
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors Positions and Employment (list of dates and roles) Other Experience and Professional Memberships
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List chronological positions and employment (with dates), and other relevant experience such as professional memberships, board service, fellowships, and honors. Include roles and years to show career progression and relevant leadership.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Selected Publications
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Publications (selected peer-reviewed publications and relevant non-peer-reviewed items)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a selected list of publications relevant to the project. Number entries and include citation details (authors, title, journal/conference, year, volume/issue/pages, PMID/doi when available). The example includes both peer-reviewed articles and relevant conference presentations or non-peer-reviewed items noted as such.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support (current and completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support (list of contracts/grants with role, dates, title, agency, and brief summary)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report current and completed research support with: funding source/contract/grant number, role (e.g., PI, Co-PI, Coinvestigator), performance period (dates), project title, agency, and a brief summary of goals and the individual's responsibilities. Indicate project status (current/selected/completed) and include pertinent details demonstrating relevant experience (e.g., scope of coordination, collaborators, deliverables).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of illustrative examples within sections
rubrics_metrics.description: The document uses concrete examples within Personal Statement, Positions, Publications and Research Support to show how to describe experience and relevance (e.g., detailed descriptions of projects, collaborations, sample collections, PI responsibilities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When writing each section, include sufficient detail on roles, responsibilities, and outcomes to demonstrate relevance and capability (e.g., describe management tasks, collaborations, sample sizes, regulatory steps taken, and how past work relates to the proposed work). Examples may be used to guide level of detail but must still fit within page limit.
